source: 1968 Chevrolet Chassis Service Manual, Steering, p.9-1

procedures.title: Manual steering gear lubricant: check and fill
steps: Check the gear lubricant level every 36,000 miles; do not drain the housing or change the grease seasonally.
Take out the lower and the outboard cover retaining screws (see figure 2 in the manual).
Fit the filling device into the lower screw hole.
notes: The gear is factory filled with water-resistant grease; top up only with water-resistant EP chassis lubricant.
All 1968 columns, including tilt and telescope options, are the energy-absorbing collapsible type (mast jacket, shift tube and steering shaft collapse in a frontal impact).
